<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="1200" viewBox="0 0 1200 1200">
  <!-- Face outline -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M240 520c-40 160 20 360 220 420 180 52 420 12 540-160 80-110 120-340 40-470-40-60-120-120-260-120-180 0-380 60-540 330z" fill="#fff" stroke="#000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Left eyebrow and eye -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M360 360c70-60 180-80 260-60" />
    <path d="M420 420c-6 18 6 46 36 56 32 10 68-4 78-22" />
    <path d="M520 420c10 0 36 6 54 18" />
  </g>

  <!-- Right eyebrow and eye -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M680 340c-40-18-120-20-180 6" />
    <path d="M740 420c6 18-6 46-36 56-32 10-68-4-78-22" />
  </g>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M590 520c6 20 18 30 30 30" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Cheek lines -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M300 600c60 40 130 60 200 70" />
    <path d="M900 600c-60 40-130 60-200 70" />
  </g>

  <!-- Mouth shape (big grin) -->
  <path d="M300 700c80 120 260 200 360 200 120 0 280-80 340-200" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Black gaps between teeth for definition -->
  <g fill="#000">
    <rect x="370" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="440" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="510" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="580" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="650" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="720" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="790" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
    <rect x="860" y="715" width="20" height="70" rx="6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rainbow teeth: eight vertical rounded rectangles, left-to-right: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, indigo, violet -->
  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="2">
    <rect x="368" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#E53935"/>
    <rect x="440" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <rect x="512" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#FDD835"/>
    <rect x="584" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#43A047"/>
    <rect x="656" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#00ACC1"/>
    <rect x="728" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#1E88E5"/>
    <rect x="800" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#5E35B1"/>
    <rect x="872" y="703" width="64" height="84" rx="12" fill="#8E24AA"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Upper lip shadow -->
  <path d="M360 690c160 70 360 70 520 0" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Chin lines -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M420 820c40 20 140 30 240 20 70-6 120-20 160-40" />
  </g>

  <!-- Final stylized small details -->
  <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M320 500c30-14 70-24 110-30" />
    <path d="M880 500c-30-14-70-24-110-30" />
  </g>
</svg>
